# AI-augmented agents

> Several agents, people and language models, on one project: delegation, coordination and incentives, with the tools of game theory, team theory and multi-agent reinforcement learning. A first review pass is written; the baseline is named.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [AI-augmented agents](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions its review must answer
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/evidence/README.md): the review behind the repository
- [Multi-agent teams](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/evidence/multi-agent-teams/README.md): the first pass, 35 sources, with the baseline B1

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/ai-augmented-agents/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
